area-isle.of.the.four.winds.mist.harbor..label: Isle Of The Four Winds Mist Harbor Town

description: Beneath a low ceiling of mosaic jeweled tiles, the gangway is an expansive chamber with a wood-paneled floor adorned with flourishes of red brass and brighter scarlet lacquer.  A gold-threaded rug proceeds from a portal in the eastern hull of the ship, a wide arch framed in gilded fireleaf.  Glimaerstones set in heavy, spiraled sconces cast steady light upon the ostentatious chamber.
title: [The Firebird, Gangway]
18260.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A cluster of glowing glimaerstones is set into the paneled wooden ceiling, encased in a globe of rainbow glaes.  They suffuse the nexus of two hallways with multihued light that awakens many hues in the grey planking of the deck.  A painted crimson door breaches one wall, standing opposite a painting of a slumbering seaside town.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck Nexus]
24410.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A meshwork of veniom cables threads across the wooden bulkheads to either side of a sealed hatchway in the western wall.  Vivid blue-green light pulses through the frame of the hatch, accompanied by a persistent thrum that disturbs the air, like thunder without sound.  The light travels through the cabling, which bores into the body of the ship at points along the hull.
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
25499.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Daylight filters in through an ornate red bronze hatch in the ceiling, the ostentatious bronzework at odds with the simple, elegant care that has gone in to the stone-colored wood of the deck and paneled walls.  A spiraling stairway ascends up toward light and open sky.  Faint metallic whistling echoes down through the aperture, muted by distance so that it almost sounds like the music of woodwinds.
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
25504.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An ornate red bronze hatch crowns the center of the upper deck, glistening from the polished greyish wood of the planking like a jewel in the sunlight.  Spiraling wooden steps proceed down into the covered main deck, their centers worn with the passage of many feet.  A ring of etched gold surrounds the hatch.
title: [The Firebird, Upper Deck]
25505.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An ornamental red brass grate in the ceiling lets in the occasional vivid glimpse of sky.  Sunlight streaming through its apertures awakens in the grey wood of the deck sparks of color that bring a fire's heart to mind.  Along the walls, a brass-marked claret door stands opposite a wing-marked carmine hatch.  Showcased on a wooden pedestal in the hallway separating them is an ancient astrolabe made of kelyn.
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
25506.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cabochon soulstones dangle from braided silver chains fastened to the ceiling, bits of emerald light glinting in their milky depths.  Bathed in their glow, a single branching ebony stand holds the only wares for sale on beds of night-hued velvet.  The sounds of the ship seem dimly muted, as if coming through swaddling cloth, though no such cloth exists to excuse the diminution.
title: [Sold Souls, Salesroom]
25507.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Framed by hanging curtains of burgundy velvet, a wide archway marks the forward end of the main deck.  It bears a rim of red brass and gold with a stylized phoenix of red lacquer at the zenith.  Nearby, a cross-hatched burnt sienna door breaks the paneled uniformity of the hallway's starboard wall.
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
25508.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bone fetishes dangle from the wood plank ceiling, swaying slightly and clacking together in the heavy, incense-laden air.  Held aloft by a faceless stone idol near the entrance, a shallow bowl of polished flowstone holds glittering baubles within.  Beyond the stolid guardian is a tiered rack made of widowwood.  Like the golvern-inlaid hatch behind it, its flat surfaces are carved with leaping beasts.
title: [Marks of the Beast, Showroom]
25509.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Talon-shaped marks are etched into the warm red oak of the wall panels bordering a small golvern-inlaid hatch, the only means of egress from the small workroom.  A tidy worktable sits beneath a flameless lamp of rainbow glaes at the room's center.  Its surface is strewn with an odd hodgepodge of divination tools and articles of the jeweler's craft.  Carved wooden masks hang from one wall, worked to resemble the faces of a variety of beasts.
title: [Marks of the Beast, Workroom]
25510.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sprawling bay windows curve around the airship's forward bulkhead, providing an extraordinary view of the landscape ahead.  The windows are positioned immediately beneath the ship's massive avian figurehead, and its outstretched metal talons hang within view.  On the opposite wall, a bar of flame maple and golden oak panels is stocked with an impressive variety of liquors, spirits, and wines, the bottles backlit by a row of glimaerstone orbs.  Several stools sit before it.
title: [The Firebird, Tip of the Talons]
25511.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shaded slightly by walls to either side supporting the port and starboard gangways, the upper deck is shielded from all but the strongest natural breezes, but not from the constant gusting of wind deflected by the whir of the propellers holding the ship aloft.  A towering blade assembly dominates the area, the crimson and golden lacquer adorning it vivid compared to the ash-colored wood of the deck.
title: [The Firebird, Upper Deck]
25512.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rising above the ship's upper deck, but not so high as the towering metal blade assemblies that propel the craft and hold it aloft, the forecastle is a swathe of space shaped like an arrowhead, tapering to a point at the bow.  The gilded and burled railing, all wrought of ash-colored fireleaf, joins with the carved bowsprit at the absolute fore of the vessel.  To the rear of the deck, broad wooden stairs proceed down toward the upper deck.
title: [The Firebird, Fo'c'sle]
25513.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Covered by an arced ceiling of transparent glaes, the sternmost portion of the upper deck is shielded from the elements.  Several chairs and tables laze underneath the faceted dome, forming a small enclave away from the bustle of the rest of the ship.  Some smooth wooden stairs form a wide path up to the smaller quarterdeck.
title: [The Firebird, Upper Deck]
25514.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The quarterdeck is a raised expanse toward the rear of the ship that looks out over the recessed upper deck.  Carved from smooth fireleaf and embellished with avian silhouettes, an ornate rail bearing a coat of gilt and red brass leaf surrounds the quarterdeck.  Luxuriant crimson pennants, each bearing a firebird in yellow embroidery, are strung between the propeller assemblies and the railing.  One strand of them flutters in the breeze, dipping low over some old wooden steps leading up to the aftercastle.
title: [The Firebird, Quarterdeck]
25515.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Huge bronze cannons glare brightly from embrasures in the crennelated railing surrounding the sterncastle, guarding the rear of the ship like dogs on the watch.  A wheel embellished with gold and crimson lacquer stands at the center of the deck, carved of the same greyish fireleaf as most of the deck plankings, but polished to a glassy smoothness by the touch of many hands.  The raised deck provides an unobstructed view all the way to the bow of the ship.
title: [The Firebird, Aftercastle]
25516.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lit from either side by a pair of glimaerstone lamps, the passage is split by a heavy red brass ladder leading down to the orlop.  The sounds of the weather deck overhead are muted by solid wood, but not entirely inaudible.  Everywhere there is a faint thrumming, as if the walls themselves were suffused with the life and pulse of a great beast.
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
25517.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Most of the narrow passageway is blocked by a heavy red brass ladder that proceeds up toward the main deck.  Veniom wires are inlaid into the wooden planks of the hull, pulsing occasionally with waves of sky blue light.  The steady pulses illuminate coiled lines and crates of cargo slumbering in the shadows.
title: [The Firebird, Orlop Deck]
25518.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crossed swords adorn one wall, still-honed edges gleaming dimly in the passway's half-light.  They hang opposite a brick-hued double door, the molding around which is marked with a pattern of interlocking feathers.  A faint acrid bite of wood polish lingers in the air.
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
25519.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Four hanging moons of colored glass hang from the overhead, lit from within to cast their commingled light on the shop foyer.  Statues, one dark and one pale, guard a trio of archways that lead off to the northeast, southeast, and east.  At the feet of each effigy sits a bowl holding a burning stick of incense, the heavy scent of which thickens the air.

Four hanging moons of colored glass hang from the overhead, lit from within to cast their commingled light on the shop foyer.  Statues, one pale and one dark, guard a trio of arches that lead off to the north, south, and east.  One of them holds a burning stick of incense, the heavy scent of which thickens the air.
title: [Covenants Kept, Entry]
25520.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A pile of braided lines blocks most of the southern hallway, aged but in good condition otherwise.  The smell of old, dry timbers is thick and sharp in the air.  What little illumination there is in the cramped space comes from sunlight burning through crevices and knots in the veniom-riveted planks forming the bulkheads.
title: [The Firebird, Orlop Deck]
25521.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The orlop terminates in a gilded red brass hatch in the northern bulkhead.  Fiery wings of gilt are painted onto the surrounding wood, spreading from the hatchway in a majestic span.  The crates and lines loading the orlop are cleared away from the entrance to allow easy access through the hatch.
title: [The Firebird, Orlop Deck]
25522.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The northernmost stretch of the main deck dead-ends into a red-dyed sephwir hatch bordered to either side with spread-winged firebirds of gold leaf.  A set of initials are carved into the port bulkhead, the smooth and glistening wood around them testament to their resistance at attempted removal.
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
25523.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Swirling with tendrils of impenetrable vapor, the moon limned on the walls is so dark as to be nearly black, but bathed in a grim aura whose shade lies at the darkest vagaries of violet.  Far in the distance behind it, almost eclipsed by the moon's bulk, is another sphere that is but a small swirl of green and blue.  Laid out before the murals is a wide bed of black velvet.
title: [Covenants Kept, Lornon Chamber]
[Covenants Kept, Black Room]
25524.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Painted across the walls in vivid greens and blues is a shining sphere, whirling with shreds of white cloud and darkened by a partial eclipse.  The occluding body has left the surface of the world half in light; half in shadow.  A wide bed of grey velvet is spread out before the jewel-toned mural, light collecting on its folds in liquid pools.
title: [Covenants Kept, Grey Chamber]
[Covenants Kept, Grey Room]
25525.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A tremendous mural dominates the bulkheads, portraying a silvery white moon at its gibbous zenith.  Two smaller moons, one dark and the other as red as flame, stand out against its pocked and riven surface.  Before the painting is spread a wide bed of white velvet, where neatly arranged wares have been laid out.
title: [Covenants Kept, Liabo Chamber]
[Covenants Kept, White Room]
25526.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A massive phoenix, wrought of fireleaf and plated with red brass and gold, spreads its wings beneath the bowsprit, screeching silent defiance at the skies.  Every feather is picked out in sheets of metal thinner than parchment.  Eyes of amber glare in the daylight, but their shine pales in comparison to the brilliance of a thousand and more glimaerstones set into the metallic plumage.  The gems collect the sun's fire and roil with greater radiance, wreathing the bird's form in flickering points of flame.
title: [The Firebird, Bowsprit]
25527.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The thin stretch of planking overlooks the lowered main deck on one side, and the Firebird's port propellers on the other.  All that stands between a clumsy passenger and a fatal topple over the side of the ship is fireleaf railing that is heavily gilded and bright with red brass ornamentation.
title: [The Firebird, Starboard Gangway]
25528.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The starboard gangway of the ship is a precarious path overlooking the bustling activity of the main deck, shielded from a drop overboard only by a red brass railing.  Whirring propellers, spreading from the hull of the ship like the wings of a bird, sing a high-pitched and metallic song, the pleasant drone of which denies the deadly nature of the blurring blades.
title: [The Firebird, Port Gangway]
25529.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Alternating glaes-banded planks stretch from one end of the catwalk to the other.  An oak and glaes shop and a saltstained teak building rest on stilts above the ocean water below, and marking the top of a wide ramp, a single sun-bleached flag rests atop a nearby wooden pillar, flapping in the ever-present ocean breeze.
title: [West Docks, Firestone Catwalk]
30238.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Neatly folded sails and coils of thick hempen rope are stacked along the polished oak floor of the academy.  Along the back, organization has gotten a bit more erratic, sporting several tipped over piles of canvas in various bright colors with thick remnants of rope snaking between them.  Resting on a sturdy teak counter is a large candle emitting a blend of smoky vetiver and citrus that mingles with, but does not eradicate, the ocean smells of the pier.
title: [Andaske's Boatswain Academy]
30239.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several intricate models of ships line the walls, each with an explanatory placard containing myriad details.  Behind the polished glaes counter are several ship flags and banners, some pristine and others in tatters, and scattered along the polished oak floors are various ship components and customizations, displayed so haphazardly as to pose a danger to the distracted customer.
title: [Valwen's Voyages]
30240.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large docking structure with five piers dominates the immediate area.  Water-roughened oak boards are edged in darkened glaes for added longevity and strength.  Saltstained teak support posts are set at regular intervals along the pier, each carved with "BMC 4997."  Myriad docking slips provide ample portage, and every slip has canvas-wrapped thick cork bumpers.  A gem-encrusted sign strung between thick strands of hemp railing reads, "West Docks, Asterfire Pier - Slips 1-5."
title: [West Docks, Asterfire Pier]
30241.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The glaes-strengthened oak pier is punctuated by teak posts set at regular intervals.  Neatly coiled piles of rope frame each docking slip, and thick cork bumpers protect the docking structure from errant ships.  A glaes-edged sign hangs between thick strands of hemp railing and reads, "West Docks, Blue Geode Pier - Slips 1-5," and underneath someone has scrawled, "Stormbrow is watching."
title: [West Docks, Blue Geode Pier]
30242.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Though not precisely spartan, none would deem the cramped quarters as lavish.  Opposite the entry hatch, a glass-windowed porthole allows a glimpse of the airship's surroundings.  Nearby hangs a gilt-framed oil painting depicting a vibrant seaside town, the bright, cool colors contrasting starkly with the pallor of the light cast by a flameless glaes lamp atop a nearby writing desk.  The bunk is neatly made but spare, clad in a green velvet blanket and with crisp white sheets and pillows.
title: [The Firebird, Quarters]

35446.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large skylight encompasses the majority of the expansive room's ceiling, bathing the room in soft moonlight.  A collection of artwork hangs on the walls, against which stands a long glass-enclosed display featuring samples of pelts and skeletons from regional creatures.  Various Terasian creatures stand stuffed and posed on a raised platform in the center of the room.
title: [Gallery, Bestiary]
35447.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A stone platform justs out like a pier over a lake of molton red lava, fed by the many tubes that flow down the rocky walls.  Crude images have been carved into the walls of the volcano, representing fiery beasts and hideous creatures.  An uneven steel staircase has been constructed along one side.  Its steps are crooked and tilted, but the bolts that secure it to the wall seem strong enough.
title: [Gallery, Inside the Eye]
35448.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Small birds flit through patches of wild flowers that dot the narrow bank along the shallows.  Grey ash clumps along the water's edge, and much of it remains trapped within the stalks of fiddlehead ferns and cattails that jut from the mud.  Tethered to a stout wooden dock, a row of soot-stained rafts bob up and down in the shallows near the glaes-inlaid, grey granite wall of Bentock's Adventurers' Rest.
title: [River Muagh, Muddy Bank]
35853.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A well-tended rock garden faces toward the river, where massive boulders, tiny pebbles, and all sizes of rocks in-between are piled into unique geometric shapes.  Bentok's Adventurers' Rest towers over the east bank, where a stout wooden dock is anchored in the shallows.  The two sides of the river bubble peacefully as they join and flow north from around the sides of Ghorsa Isle.
title: [River Muagh]
35854.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The town walls of Kharam-Dzu rise from either side of a steep, granite-faced canyon that guides the river north.  Flowing at a steady pace, the crystal clear waters reveal the darting shapes of numerous fish as they contend for the prized meal of other, smaller fish.
title: [River Muagh]
35855.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The river flows languidly northward, lapping against the sheer walls of a ruddy granite canyon on both sides.  Atop the eastern canyon wall, the highroad parallels the path of the river before veering behind an outcropping of pearl grey boulders.  A gnarled root juts from the canyon wall, casting a jagged shadow across the moonlit waters.
title: [River Muagh, Granite Canyon]
35856.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The canyon walls rise high above the river on both sides, and visible clusters of dark obsidian and basalt contrast sharply against the otherwise ruddy and grey-veined granite.  The water flows steadily north, taking tiny clumps of fallen grey ash along with it.
title: [River Muagh, Granite Canyon]
35857.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sheer, granite canyon walls taper downwards from the south, the ends eroded and cracked as the landscape transitions into a muddy, verdant expanse of canver and mistwood trees to the north.  Considerably wide and deep, the river flows into white-capped rapids from the canyon's base.
title: [River Muagh, Granite Canyon]
35858.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Churning, white-capped waters flow northward, between patches of smoothed rocks that protrude above the surface near the foot of a tall granite canyon to the south.  The width of the river makes it a rather simple task of avoiding any hazards.
title: [River Muagh, Rapids]
35859.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The rushing waters of the river are met by a surging, tributary stream from the eastern bank, and the flow of the river shifts northward as it meanders between crowded canver and mistwood trees.  Thin, thorn-covered vines hang from gnarled branches that reach over the water's edge, and have conglomerated along the eastern bank.
title: [River Muagh, Confluence]
35860.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Quickly moving waters flow west from a deep pool to the south, the bend here sharply turning where a granite outcropping interrupts the treeline.  The branches of canver trees extend over the stream and entwine with each other, while verdant undergrowth saturates every traversable space beneath them.
title: [River Muagh, Tributary Stream]
35861.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crashing down a rocky, moss-covered ridge to the south, a towering waterfall pours into a wide pool that feeds into the River Muagh as the current sweeps it north.   A verdant bank flanks a rugged wooden dock, which looks oddly out of place amid the foliage.
title: [River Muagh, Waterfall]
35862.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lush, interlaced canver trees cluster along a verdant bank, covered in numerous colonies of mushrooms and surrounded by patches of cattails and fiddlehead ferns.  Dangling from their branches, a plethora of pink-throated white blossoms provide a starkly contrasting canopy to the thunderheads that darken the sky.  Tiny golden and silvery fish dart around some soot-stained rafts tethered to a rugged wooden dock, in a constant race after each petal that falls into the current.
title: [River Muagh, Verdant Bank]
35863.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Slumped over amid passionflowers, heliconia, and other tropical flora, a bowed ancient canver tree has crushed another of its kind beneath its significant girth.  Insects buzz and flit through the enormous, tangled mass that is the tree's branches, entrenched in a sea of pink and white blossoms.  The splintered husk of the crushed tree lies half-buried alongside the depressed mud of the trail, now home to a family of noisily chirping crickets.
title: [Teras Isle, Verdant Trail]
35864.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fruit-bearing trees reach skyward along both sides of the trail, surrounded by patches of wild growth.  The smooth, grey granite of a wall peeks through the foliage to the east, and a layer of fog undulates near the ground.
title: [Teras Isle, Verdant Trail]
35865.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Secured by heavily reinforced hinges on a grey granite wall, an invar-banded gate is guarded by a small parapet to either side.  The wall extends north and south, beyond numerous rows of sturdy saplings, curving from view as it bends to encircle the settlement beyond.  Armored dwarves stand at attention within each parapet, crossbows at the ready.
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Approach]
35866.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An invar-banded gate rests in a half-opened position, at the ready to barricade the settlement against the wild denizens of Teras Isle.  Opposite the gate, a raised invar portcullis serves as the second line of defense, its sharp tines held in position above the cobblestone threshold leading into Kragnek Dzu.
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Vestibule]
35867.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Masterfully carved cobblestones are aligned in opposing spirals, their roughly textured surfaces and contrasting hues contributing to the artfully detailed masonry.  Armored and uniformed dwarves stand guard in parapets on the granite wall to either side of a raised gleaming invar portcullis, the settlement's only defensible entryway.  A magnificent fountain splashes noisily to the east in the center of a concave plaza.
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Promenade West]
35868.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dominating the central gathering area of Kragnek Dzu, a magnificent fountain towers over a masterfully constructed concave plaza.  Water bubbles and splashes between colorful, chromatic glaes fragments in a wide carved stone basin that surrounds the fountain's centerpiece, a massive teardrop of pure white glaes artistically formed as if plummeting into the basin just above the water's surface.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Crater Plaza]
35869.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The north quarter of the promenade meets a quickly moving stream.  Babbling and splashing turbulently northwest, the stream flows under a short stone bridge before curving out of sight through an invar grate in the settlement's wall.  A short barrier of dark glaes protects the cobblestones near the water's edge.  To the south, a magnificent fountain rivals the noisy babbling of the stream.
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Promenade North]
35870.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cobblestone path of the promenade divides and weaves between colorful dwellings and varied merchant stalls, adjoining a row of stone houses to the south, a small market to the east, and a magnificent fountain to the north.  Constantly falling grey ash has been pushed into small piles at each corner, either intentionally or by the heavy amount of traffic moving through the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, northwest
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Promenade South]
35871.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cobblestones meet at a crossroads in the east quarter of the promenade, where a briskly moving narrow stream splatters along the settlement's northern edge.  Rushing from its source to the east, the stream bends sharply along smoothed, granite stonework.  On the opposite bank, a cluster of mangroves and taller trees form a tightly compacted, impenetrable wall of wild growth.  To the west, you can hear the splashing of water as it lands in the basin of a magnificent fountain.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, west, northwest
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Promenade East]
35872.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cobblestones of the promenade come to a sudden end, transitioning into a rugged gravel road.  Alongside the road is a narrow stream that gushes forth from a bubbling hot spring, its surface layered with roiling fog.  A stout stone mill resides between the promenade and the spring, its waterwheel turning steadily in the rushing waters.  Berry-laden bushes grow between mushroom-covered mangroves along the opposite bank.
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Stone Mill Road]
35873.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Large, artfully carved blocks of mistwood are pushed against the walls, serving as makeshift tables amid a sea of casks used as seating throughout the hall.  The raucous clinking of mugs and boisterous storytelling does little to drown out the constant drone of the mill's waterwheel.  An old long-bearded dwarf stands amid a circular mistwood bar in the middle of it all, shifting his attention between a ruddy clay stove and a wooden rack full of glass bottles.
title: [Stone Mill, Mead Hall]
35874.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rising steam forms into layers of mist and fog that turbulently shift across the surface of the opaque, pale white waters of the bubbling spring.  A stream of the upwelled water has carved its way through the irregularly shaped rocks surrounding the spring, splashing along some carved grey granite steps leading to Stone Mill Road.
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Hot Spring]
35875.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Booths and stalls comprise a busy market that serves as a hub of commerce within Kragnek Dzu, bustling with activity as crafters and merchants toil away with their wares.  A small stone shop stands in the middle of the market, displaying a row of finely crafted, colorful metal scabbards in its only visible window.  Large canver trees entwine their branches over a walkway leading southwest, toward a row of squat stone houses.
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Ragnak Market]
35876.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Squat stone houses are arranged in two rows along a short, ruddy road of smooth granite cobblestones, the paths leading to the entrance of each dwelling boasting myriad pieces of colorful glaes artwork.  Large canver trees entwine their branches over a walkway leading northeast, toward a small market.
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Ragnak Row]
35877.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cobblestones abruptly end where a massive glaes dais is anchored into the ground beneath its center, and supported around its circumference by uniform, grey granite pillars.  A towering grove of mistwood trees form a dense barrier around the dais, interspersed with thick brambles and patches of wild flora.
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Glaes Court]
35878.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The flat, smooth surface of the dais is covered in a layer of perpetually falling grey ash.  Other than where the dais connects to some wide, stone steps leading down to the cobblestones of Glaes Court, seven granite pillars support the dais at equal intervals around its circumference.  Crowning each pillar is an artistically symbolic statue of a tool crafted with apparent dwarven styling: an adze, an anvil, an awl, a chisel, a grinding wheel, a hammer, and a hand saw.
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Glaes Dais]
35879.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Symbols of the Arkati are carved into the walls of this tidy shop.  Dwarves hurry between spools of metallic wire and a tool-covered workbench, and short lengths of bent metal wire are organized in rows across its surface.  Completed talismans are displayed on small hooks, dangling from a long wooden rod.
title: [Adorned Deliverance]
35880.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The angular interior of this building is crafted from carved sections of wood and stone, comprised of short hallways adjoining a row of six workrooms to this chamber.  A vaulted ceiling curves upward from each of the glaes-framed archways that mark the entrance to each workroom, forming a wooden dome that is carved in bas-relief with emblems of various flora and fauna.  Each emblem is arranged within one of many concentric circles, centered around a Ragnak Clan crest at the ceiling's concave apex.

The other side of the shop is lined with fully stocked shelves, attended to by a pair of young dwarves dressed in white-striped, teal and grey uniforms.  A pair of wrought invar lanterns, one on each side of the shop's large window, provide ample amounts of light.

description: Smoothed timbers of fruitwood trees are lashed together into a frame and floor for this sturdy, elevated booth, upon which myriad weapons are hung for display.  Superbly masoned river stone half-walls are capped by windowed sections of lattice, arranged between upright, carved stone pillars at the booth's two furthest ends.  A bead-shrouded opening at either end provides one way in and one way out, each angled toward the bustling market of Kragnek Dzu.
title: [Ragnak Clan Cuts]
35888.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Opened, free-standing displays in this enclosed stall offer samples of various ruddy brown armors, from cloth and soft leathers to chain and plate.  One display has four distinct types of shields mounted to its opened doors, framing the suits of plate armor within.  Another supports an arrangement of horizontal poles supported by both sides of a large cabinet, each dangling robes and leathers of slightly different design and size.  A dwarven artisan attends to patrons as they approach to barter and haggle.
title: [Ragnak Clan Defenses]
35889.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The settlement's clan hall stands proudly in the middle of a large rock garden filled with smooth pink, blue, grey, white, and black stones of different sizes.  Dark glaes statues of dwarves holding myriad crafting tools decorate a carved stone path leading to the hall's glaes-framed entrance.  A clustered treeline almost completely encircles the area, broken only by a short stone bridge that traverses a quickly moving stream to the south.
title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Rock Garden]
35890.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In sharp contrast to the stone construction of the hall's floor and ceiling, panels of blonde mistwood cover the lower half of the walls in this spacious entryway.  Each panel is decorated with a row of colorful, dwarf-cut gemstones along its beveled top, where the wall transitions to smooth grey stone.  A young dwarf stands attentively near a short granite table to one side of a strip of grey-bordered, dark green carpet that leads north.
title: [Clan Hall, Entrance]
35891.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long strip of grey-bordered dark green carpet ends at a row of wide, curved stone steps leading up to an elaborate eonake-framed podium and a row of carved stone seats behind it.  To either side of the carpet, grey granite pews are arranged to face the podium.  A pair of invar-framed lanterns hang from chains overhead, one to each side of the raised platform upon which the podium stands.
title: [Clan Hall, Meeting Chamber]
35892.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A narrow outcropping of crystal-flecked granite juts from the surface of the river on the west bank, towering over the younger trees growing along the water's edge.  Grey ash striates the muddy, flower-covered banks as it slowly washes into the water's edge.
title: [River Muagh, Ashen Bend]
35893.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The river is wide and calm as it curves between an impassable barrier of mangroves, trees, ferns, and cattails along each bank.  Constantly falling grey ash muddles the clarity of the surface, stretching into a thin film that floats and clings together.
title: [River Muagh, Ashen Bend]
35894.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wide and slow, the river meanders northward between clustered mistwood trees that tower over the banks on both sides.  Tiny black birds flit through the branches, the bravest occasionally diving into the tall grasses to find a snack.
title: [River Muagh, Mangroves]
35895.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The river meanders between wide, mangrove-laden banks, burbling as it flows eagerly toward the sea.  Dark, jagged cliffs are barely visible above the treeline to the north, almost hidden within the churning maelstrom of black clouds overhead.
title: [River Muagh, Mangroves]
35896.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A forest of mistwood and canver trees to the south comes to a sudden halt as dark cliffs jut towards the sky on both sides of the river.  The sky is filled with pitch black thunderheads; a churning amalgamation of raw power.
title: [River Muagh, Dark Cliffs]
35897.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Barren of life, the dark cliffs are jagged and inhospitable.  The winds from a churning black maelstrom roar above the cliffs and blow harshly through a wide channel carved through them by the river's unending quest to flow into the Obsidian Sea.
title: [River Muagh, Dark Cliffs]
35898.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A churning black maelstrom blocks the sky on the eastern, seaward facing side of lifeless, dark cliffs that flank the river along both banks.  The wind whips about with an intensity only rivaled by dwarves charging toward free ale, and surging waves from the Obsidian Sea meet the River Muagh head on.  A battered raft tethered to a jagged basalt ledge is caught in a constant, turbulent mix of brackish water, tossed one way, then the other.
title: [River Muagh, Mouth]
35899.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The angled surface of the ledge is worn smooth from countless years of scouring rain, though its seaward-facing edge is sharp and jagged from undercutting waves battering it relentlessly.  Fierce swells continuously crash against a row of basalt rocks near a dark cave leading into the cliffside, forcing seawater violently upward toward the churning maelstrom that roils across the skyline.
title: [River Muagh, Basalt Ledge]
35900.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Layers of dried blood and soot cover the walls and floor of this towering cave.  Deep slashes and gouges mar the walls where tools or weapons have struck with great force, revealing deep black basalt beneath the surface.
